rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full overlap with the credential/reputation substituting for independent verification mechanism, but the named construct is wrong.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 2 to 4; strict instance true positives increase from 2 to 3, while one correctly localized but mislabeled Authority Bias finding becomes a strict false positive and a mechanism-first true positive.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The ambiguity-effect candidate is admitted, adding one segment hit and one strict and mechanism-first instance true positive.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold: 4/5 positive segments detected, 1 miss, 0 false alarms, 3 correct rejections; hit rate 0.8000, false-alarm rate 0.0000, F1 0.8889.

overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate: 4 true positives, 2 false negatives, and 0 false positives; precision 1.0000, recall 0.6667, F1 0.8000.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Useful: the single conservative candidate correctly identifies the remaining ambiguity-effect mechanism and becomes a true positive at the candidate-inclusive threshold without creating a false alarm.
main_failure_modes: One Authority Bias occurrence is labeled confirmation bias, producing a strict taxonomy error despite full mechanism and location overlap.
The Optimism bias occurrence is not identified.
The Ambiguity effect is only proposed as a candidate until the fourth threshold.
main_strengths: Exact high-confidence detection of Clustering illusion and Base-Rate Neglect.
Faithful quote localization and mechanism descriptions for all four identified findings.
Correctly identifies the retrospective Hindsight bias occurrence at moderate confidence.
No unsupported or negative-segment false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run shows strong conservative segment detection and good mechanism coverage, but strict label accuracy is reduced by one taxonomy substitution and one missed optimism occurrence. Mechanism-first scoring materially improves the recommended-threshold F1 from 0.6000 to 0.8000; the candidate tier recovers the ambiguity occurrence.
